g.text: «Port» / «Adapter» MessageBus is the port the code depends
on; InMemoryBus is the adapter in use. The NATS adapter of
the Part B plan is not built.
«Subscriber» topic in: sim.suppression.v1; the cells are
queued with apply_suppression() and applied next tick.
The API creates sessions without a publisher, so events flow
only where a bus is wired (the messaging tests).
Grey class: defined in the engine-core diagram.
